title: Docking — sirolimus/FKBP axis + sulfasalazine/xCT (Vina 1.2.7, CPU)
method: AutoDock Vina 1.2.7, exhaustiveness 8 (macrocycles) / 24 (small mol), num_modes 9, energy_range 3. Ligand prep: meeko 0.8 (SMILES from PubChem, verified) or crystal-conformation ligand (obabel->RDKit->meeko). Receptor prep: meeko mk_prepare_receptor (gasteiger, polar H). Boxes: centered on co-crystallized ligand, size = ligand extent + 8A. Structures: RCSB PDB, chain identities verified via UniProt accession.
confidence: medium-low — scores are directional evidence only; docking is hypothesis generation, MD (Phase 2) is the pose arbiter. Macrocycle pose RMSD limited by Vina rigid-ring treatment.

FKBP52/FKBP4.note: No FKBP4-ligand complex in PDB; pocket located by contact-defined structural alignment onto FKBP12-rapamycin (14 pocket residues, 0.80A RMSD)

xCT/SLC7A11.native_ligand: J9O (erastin-class quinazolinone, C30H31ClN4O4; deposited as 'erastin-bound' but NOT classic erastin C32H31ClN4O4)

calibrations.read: Converged (-9.35 at ex24 AND ex64, identical). Docked pose sits 6.9A from crystal centroid, deeper in the substrate cavity, 0 clashes; at 3.4A cryo-EM resolution the deposited ligand pose carries +/-2-3A model uncertainty and density often cannot distinguish such modes. Pocket binding validated; exact pose unverifiable at this resolution -> MD arbiter.

Score consistent with known FKBP12-rapamycin binding. Pose RMSD ~6A from crystal even with crystal-conformation ligand: Vina treats macrocycle rings as rigid, so full ring-conformation matching is outside its regime. Binding validated by score + pocket; pose needs MD.

target_docks.comparison: 0.83 kcal/mol weaker than native J9O (-9.35) in the same pocket — consistent with sulfasalazine's known weaker xCT affinity vs erastin-class inhibitors (WATCHLIST unchanged; selectivity/toxicity, not binding, is the blocker)

target_docks.ligand_source: crystal RAP from 1FKB (identical conformation to FKBP12 calibration)
target_docks.comparison: 0.68 kcal/mol weaker than rapamycin->FKBP12 (-7.06) with MATCHED ligand conformations — FKBP4 pocket accepts sirolimus nearly as well as FKBP12 (consistent with ChEMBL FKBP4 engagement = real binding; the M3 'promiscuity' note). Small FKBP12/FKBP52 delta means FKBP4 engagement is plausible at clinical doses — relevant to the progesterone-resistance chaperone hypothesis.
target_docks.note: SMILES-conformation sirolimus gave -6.17 (0.51 delta); crystal-conformation -6.38 (0.68 delta) is the cleaner comparison.

grounds: 7S8L MRGPRX2 chain has 35 truncated sidechains (cryo-EM), including pocket-lining residues — docking into artificially truncated pocket residues produces misleading scores
Cetrorelix is a 1431 Da decapeptide with 38 rotatable bonds — beyond Vina's validated regime (32-bond default, small-molecule design)
cetrorelix_mrgprx2.recommendation: Defer to Phase 2 peptide-MD or a peptide-capable docking tool (HPEPDOCK/CABS-dock class). Phase 0.5 already shows MRGPRX2/mast-cell enrichment is endometrioma-specific, absent in peritoneal lesions — tempers this target's priority.

admet: admet_profile.json — 9 M3 candidates (RDKit: MW, alogP, HBD/HBA, rotB, TPSA, RO5, Veber, QED). Estradiol/sulfasalazine rule-compliant; macrocycles (sirolimus/tacrolimus/CsA) break RO5 yet are marketed oral drugs; cetrorelix = parenteral peptide.
next: Phase 2 (MD): OpenMM 100-500ns on top poses (sulfasalazine->xCT, sirolimus->FKBP52) as pose arbiter. GPU needed (RunPod ~$5-25 or knight capacity).
reproducibility: Scripts: /opt/data/phase1/work/*.py (not in repo — run on owned VPS). Input structures: RCSB PDB IDs above. Vina 1.2.7 static binary, meeko 0.8, RDKit 2026.03.
